_comment: The published trainer image the orchestration pulls and runs. Written only by the pipeline's publish step (`.github/workflows/image.yml`, `temper_control_plane.publish_trainer_image`), which builds the image from `trainer_build.TRAINER_SOURCES`, pushes it, and verifies it is pullable by digest. The digest is the contract and the tag is a comment, exactly like the Dockerfile's FROM line: the machine pulls `<reference>` -- image@digest -- never a tag, so what runs is exactly what was built and verified by the pipeline. A digest change is a deliberate, visible change because it lands as its own pull request. When `published` is false there is no reference and a real job refuses loudly rather than pulling a made-up image.
